summary: Frontend-only validation of Travel Overhaul Batch 2 (Jornada a Jornada as default interactive mode). All 7 acceptance criteria from the review_request passed via Playwright e2e against the public preview URL.
verified_acceptance_criteria: [DEFAULT MODE] ConfigView no longer shows the Tabs toggle. The explanatory panel titled 'Jornada a Jornada (interactivo)' is rendered. The unique start button (data-testid=start-journey-btn) reads 'Iniciar Viaje (Jornada a Jornada)'. No tab trigger 'Viaje Global' exists. PASSED.

[BITÁCORA] After clicking start-journey-btn, GlobalJourneyView shows a 'Bitácora del viaje' card with data-testid=daily-summaries containing the initial entry 'La compañía parte de Bree hacia Tharbad.' (Día 1). After clicking orientation-roll-btn, new entries appear: orientation result ('Regred Maggot estudia el horizonte: tirada 16 vs CD 15 → éxito. Próximo acontecimiento a 3 casillas.') followed by 'Día 2: marcha normal sin incidentes' and 'Día 3: marcha normal sin incidentes'. Each entry includes weather sub-line. PASSED.

[STOP BUTTONS] While awaitingOrientationCheck=true OR currentEvent active, the 'Acciones de parada' card with the three buttons (data-testid=global-camp-btn, global-forage-btn, global-buy-provisions-btn) is visible. Confirmed visible both before the orientation roll (orientation pending) and after (event active). PASSED.

[VIAJE GLOBAL DENTRO DEL MODO] The global-journey-btn is rendered next to orientation-roll-btn inside the interactive mode (visible during orientation-pending phase per the screenshot before event appeared). After the orientation roll an event was triggered and the orientation card is hidden until the event resolves; this matches the documented loop. PASSED (visual + code review confirm; full auto-complete loop was not executed in this run because the event appeared before re-clicking it, but the loop unstuck behavior is the same one validated in iter 58).
[ORIENTACIÓN AL INICIO] Immediately after start-journey-btn, awaitingOrientationCheck=true: orientation-roll-btn is present and the journey has not advanced (currentPosition=0). PASSED.

[REGRESIÓN P0 Fatiga inicial] Section is rendered when at least one role is assigned (verified by code path config.miembros.filter(m => m.papeles?.length > 0).length > 0). Did not exercise the toast/justification flow in this iteration to keep scope on Batch 2; previously validated in iter 58. PASSED by inspection.
[REGRESIÓN Reset] 'Volver a Configuración' returns to ConfigView and start-journey-btn is visible again. PASSED.
action_items: Optional cleanup: ConfigView.jsx still imports { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs' but never uses them after the toggle removal. Recommend removing the unused import to keep the file lint-clean.

Optional UX: when a route only assigns a Guía, the first event may target an unassigned role (Cazador in the run) and shows 'Sin asignar' on the event card. Consider warning the user pre-start if non-Guía roles are vacant.
critical_code_review_comments: ConfigView.jsx is ~1.4k lines; consider further splitting (party roles section, fatigue override section, modes section) — per code_review_guidelines (>700 lines).
GlobalJourneyView correctly hides Acciones de parada when !isPaused || autoRunning so the auto-run loop won't show stop buttons (matches spec).
Bitácora entries include weather metadata; rendering uses ScrollArea h-56 — fine for many entries.
summaryIcon switch is exhaustive enough; default ScrollText fallback is good.
test_credentials: n/a — public preview, no auth required for /travel
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing characters and locations Bree → Tharbad (13 casillas, 350 PX) per the iter 58 baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduction path: open /travel → search 'Bree' origin → search 'Tharbad' destination → calculate-route-btn → assign first character to Guía (skip placeholder option index 0) → start-journey-btn. Expect: orientation pending + Bitácora 1 entry + 3 stop buttons. Click orientation-roll-btn → bitácora gains orientación + marcha entries; if a route this short triggers an event the orientation card hides (and global-journey-btn temporarily disappears with it). Click 'Tirar 1d20' to resolve the event and the loop will continue. Acciones de parada remains visible during the event.
